scope: Explicit acceptance of original surface classification10,typography scale29,spacing definition34 andradius roles35. No uniform runtime adoption claim.

root_review.method: Read exact original requirements/conditions,complete family taxonomy anddesign-role mapping. Reviewed current token roles/selectors,documented responsive/fixed exceptions,andindependent source verdicts. Full styles migration andcomputed cascade outcomes are distinct unaccepted requirements.

items.requirement: Classify reusable surfaces into pages, panels, record cards, tables, editors, dialogs and contextual overlays.

conditions.condition: Classify reusable surfaces as pages, panels, record cards, tables, editors, dialogs or contextual overlays
conditions.rationale: Taxonomy explicitly classifies pages, panels, member/unit record cards, record editors, native dialogs, contextual overlays, menus/drawers, inline disclosure and feedback. Separate table-family section distinguishes comparative grids, record lists, structured editors, review lists and inactive literals.

conditions.condition: Link each family to existing source and describe its presentation/interaction boundary
conditions.rationale: Each family names existing modules/selector/function contexts and presentation/interaction boundaries. Verified NAV_ITEMS19 entries and current role filter; member-card/unit-card source markup; review overlay markup; native member/compute dialog opening; record/reference draft boundaries. New Server details family explicitly reconciled.

items.requirement: Establish a clear typography scale for page titles, panel headings, field labels, body text and metadata.

conditions.condition: Define a clear scale for page titles, panel headings, field labels, body copy and metadata
conditions.rationale: Document maps requested hierarchy to page title text-2xl24-30, panel text-md16, field label text-sm14, body text-base16, metadata text-xs12. It distinguishes generic h3/dialog/metric roles and explicitly records exceptions rather than pretending all heading levels mean one visual role.

conditions.condition: Link the scale to shared tokens and role-specific selectors so intended hierarchy is reproducible
conditions.rationale: Read premium token declarations and concrete shared selectors: h2/text-2xl, panel h3/text-md, label/text-sm, body/text-base, help/eyebrow/text-xs. Main imports premium after legacy. Role mappings are reproducible declaration-level definitions; no computed-value or migration claim inferred.

items.requirement: Define consistent spacing tokens for page gutters, card padding, field groups, toolbars and stacked mobile actions.

conditions.condition: Define consistent page gutter, card padding, field group, toolbar and mobile stack spacing tokens
conditions.rationale: Existing4px shared spacing tokens define4/8/12/16/20/24/32/40/48. Document explicitly maps page gutters through current safe-area/clamp responsive role expressions, card/panel padding, field-grid/label gaps, toolbar clusters and mobile wrapped-action spacing. Dedicated semantic aliases are not necessary to establish mappings using existing shared values. Literal/responsive exceptions are disclosed, not presented as completed uniform adoption.

conditions.condition: Document the scale and intended role mappings using existing shared values
conditions.rationale: Scale and all five requested role mappings documented with concrete declarations and mobile overrides. Explicitly identifies absence of named gutter/card-padding aliases,10pxfooter gap,12px mobile footer and wrapping semantics. These are migration/adoption limits; the definition does not invent nonexistent role aliases.

items.requirement: Establish distinct radius tokens for fields, cards, dialogs and status chips instead of indiscriminate pill shapes.

conditions.condition: Define distinct field, card, dialog and status-chip radius roles
conditions.rationale: Distinct roles map ordinary fields tosm8, compact cards tomd10, panels/ordinary cards tolg16, major dialogs toxl20, status chips tofull999. Verified field/card/panel/dialog/status declarations; canonical fields10px and fullheight mobile0px are explicit exceptions. Generic geometric token names are sufficient to define distinct documented role assignments.

conditions.condition: Document intentional compact/pill exceptions so ordinary surfaces do not receive indiscriminate pill shapes
evidence: docs/premium-ui/design-role-mappings.md: Radius and compact status roles; frontend/src/styles.css:663-674,1435-1448,1755-1762,4880
conditions.rationale: Document restricts pill-role exception to compact textual status/count badges and states ordinary fields/cards/dialogs are not authorized pill roles. It separately identifies period badge hardcoding, identity-chip pill and asymmetric navigation as existing adoption exceptions; it does not infer approval/rationale for every legacy pill. This meets definition condition; elimination/reconciliation of all legacy shapes remains separate implementation work.

limitations: No global style migration, computed cascade, screenshot, action outcome, accessibility or mobile runtime acceptance inferred.
Low-specificity :where radius declarations may lose to legacy class selectors; documentation acknowledges this correctly.

Spacing maps existing scale and responsive expressions; absent semantic aliases and10pxfooter exception are disclosed. This review does not require adding aliases solely to close a definition requirement.
Member-identity/navigation pill keep/change decisions remain adoption work; neither is silently certified as an intentional approved status exception.

Table literal candidate count/per-instance reachability belongs to broader inventory/requirement101 acceptance; requirement10 family classification is not a complete per-instance operational inventory.
